page.overview:
Who is Bennet Sten?

Bennet Sten was a human smuggler and thief who brought medical supplies and foodstuff to people in need across the Outer Rim Territories with his partner Myler Sten. He eventually had a son, Yuko, and created multiple holorecordings of himself with Myler and Yuko in their hidden home on the planet Tatooine. The family also had two droids, a bear-like caretaker droid BILY and a small triangle droid. At some point, the family stole something valuable to the pirate captain Fox-Ear. In a skirmish between the Stens and some starfighters, a starship crashed into their own. After Bennet and Myler's eventual deaths from sickness, BILY watched after and took care of Yuko.

Fox-Ear's pirate gang eventually tracked down the Stens' child and attempted to retrieve their stolen treasure. The pirates were eventually defeated by a krayt dragon while trying to infiltrate the family's bunker. BILY took Yuko into the old home, where the droid dusted the parents' graves and Yuko witnessed the recordings created by Bennet and Myler.

At some point, Bennet Sten became a smuggler with the Tatooine within the Jundland Wastes. The bunker had a handprint lock openable by Yuko.

The Stens recorded several moments with their child on holograms, including a point where Myler held Yuko in her arms while Yuko held on to Bennet's finger as the couple laughed. Later, they recorded a moment when Myler fed Yuko with a spoon and Bennet told him that he did a good job. Another recording featured the parents measuring Yuko's height on a wall, where Bennet placed a pair of goggles on his son's head and said he may grow bigger than even himself. A final recording was taken in front of their starship.
